verdict.rationale: Finix documents its own automated reporting: more than 10 report types, covering transactions, disputes and fees, are automated and available in the dashboard. Seller payouts can be managed via the Dashboard or API. That is first-party reconciliation-adjacent reporting, but the evidence shows dashboard access only, not file or API delivery to a finance stack on a schedule. missing for 10: settlement/balance report APIs or file exports, scheduled delivery, per-seller and rolled-up report breakdowns, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, reconciliation is automatable — settlement and balance reports per seller and rolled up, delivered as files or APIs my finance stack consumes on schedule

citations.quote: From transactions to disputes and fees, more than 10 report types are automated and available in your personal dashboard
You can manage how sellers get paid out using the Finix Dashboard or our API.
